comment: Aether Echoes — lore collectibles found throughout the world.

echoes.name: The Creator's Last World
echoes.text: The Creator God, on His deathbed, wove one final world. But it was unbalanced. So He created five more, joining them like faces of a cube.

echoes.name: The Dragon-God War
echoes.text: The First Dragon God waged war across all worlds. God after God fell. Only the Human God survived, gathering refugees to a single world.

echoes.name: The Birth of Orsted
echoes.text: Orsted was born of the Dragon God and the Human God's daughter. A demi-god. Destined to fight a war that would never end.

echoes.name: Laplace's Rebellion
echoes.text: Laplace was once a hero. But something twisted him. He became the Demon God, and the world burned.

echoes.name: The Superd Genocide
echoes.text: After Laplace fell, his people were hunted. The Superd were nearly wiped out. Ruijerd carries the weight of a genocide he did not cause.

echoes.name: The Founding of Ranoa
echoes.text: The Ranoa Magic University was built on the ruins of an ancient mage tower. Its foundations contain spells long forgotten.

echoes.name: The Lost Prince
echoes.text: Zanoba was the eighth prince of Shirone. Far from succession, he found purpose not in crowns but in creation.

echoes.name: The Greyrat Lineage
echoes.text: The Greyrat family once served the Asuran kings directly. Their loyalty was rewarded with land. Their stubbornness, with exile.

echoes.name: The First Magic Armor
echoes.text: Rudeus and Zanoba's collaboration was unprecedented. A mage who could not fight in close quarters built a suit of armor that let him stand among kings.

echoes.name: Hitogami's Prison
echoes.text: Hitogami was sealed in the Void World between realities. He cannot touch the physical world. But he can whisper. And people listen.
